diagnosis.small_pool: The five-second MIP reached optimality on the 100-customer tasks, but a feasible checked route-pool incumbent was decoded a second time, discarding its selected vehicle types and charging actions and potentially erasing a strict improvement.
diagnosis.large_pool: Expanded pools of roughly 1397 to 1795 routes often returned no incumbent or a remaining gap under the five-second cap.

frozen_repair.mip_acceptance_rule: Accept the exact selected routes, vehicle types, charging actions, and depot assignments only after an independent full-model recheck and objective closure within rel_tol 1e-9 and abs_tol 1e-6. Never send the accepted incumbent through the greedy route-skeleton decoder again.
frozen_repair.mip_time_reason: One fixed upper limit is used for every task; an optimal solve exits early. Thirty seconds is a safety cap intended to obtain an incumbent for the largest observed pools, not a result-dependent per-instance setting.

failure_rule: Reject unchanged if any invariant fails or any registered count threshold is missed. Do not alter search depth, checkpoints, seed, cases, MIP limit, budget cap, or thresholds after results. Do not rerun failed pairs.
claim_boundary: Development only. Passing requires one further independently frozen confirmation before formal E2 adoption.
